verdict.rationale: Docusaurus provides strong first-party evidence for full brand customization: custom global CSS via /src/css/custom.css, swizzling to swap/override theme components, React/MDX support to build fully custom components, and a pluggable architecture for layout extension. Community feedback corroborates React/theming flexibility as a key strength. missing for 10: no independent hands-on case study specifically showing a DevRel team fully rebranding fonts/layout end-to-end, and no dedicated font-customization doc excerpt.
